'''Wollwi Enan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]] who lived in the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At an [[Youngling/Legends|early age]], they were discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and taken to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]].<ref name="SWI" /> In [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{Facebook|username=ed.erdelac|url=ed.erdelac/posts/10202287303437351|name=[[Edward M. Erdelac]]|date=2014-01-21|archivefile=File:EdwardMErdelac-Malleus-Facebook.png|nolive=1}}</ref> Enan participated in the Temple's [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Jedi Temple Apprentice Tournament|tournament]] as part of the [[Initiate Trials/Legends|Apprentice Trials]]. During that competition, Enan [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] and bested their fellow [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi youngling]] [[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]].<ref name="SWI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wollwi Enan was first mentioned in "[[Hammer (short story)|Hammer]]," a short story written by [[Edward M. Erdelac]] for the [[Star Wars Insider 147|147th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI" /> which was published on [[January 21]], [[2014]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/147|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #147}}</ref> "Wollwi Enan" is an anagram of "Willow Anne," which is the name of Erdelac's daughter.<ref name="Blog">{{WordPress|subdomain=emerdelac|name=Delirium Tremens: The Blog of Author Edward M. Erdelac|url=2014/01/21/hammer-time-star-wars-insider-148|text=Hammer Time! Star Wars Insider #147|author=Edward M. Erdelac|archivedate=20140922145355}}</ref>
